**Finding: COMPLIANT (preferred)** — no redline proposed.

§ 8.2 and § 8.3 together meet every preferred element:
- **12-month renewal terms** — "renews for successive twelve-month periods" (no multi-year auto-renewal).
- **30-day opt-out** — "at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal," and Customer's deadline is extended if Vendor misses its reminder.
- **60-day Vendor reminder** — "Vendor shall remind Customer of an upcoming renewal at least sixty days beforehand."
- **Uplift cap** — "only by the lesser of the increase in the United States Consumer Price Index ... and three percent," plus 90 days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods.

§ 7 (Fees) and § 9 (Termination) carry no competing renewal or uplift mechanic, so the rule is fully satisfied without amendment.
